chart.prior_note_excerpt: Visit 2026-06-10: HbA1c 7.8%. BP 136/84. Advised diet control and walking 30 minutes daily. Continue metformin 500 mg BD and amlodipine 5 mg OD.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Good morning Mr. Kumar, please have a seat.
utterances.asr_text: Good morning Mr. Kumar, please have a seat.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Good morning doctor. Arre, the traffic was terrible today, one hour from Sector 22.
utterances.asr_text: Good morning doctor. Arre, the traffic was terrible today, one hour from Sector 22.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Everyone is out after the cricket match.
utterances.asr_text: Everyone is out after the cricket match.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: So, what brings you in today?
utterances.asr_text: So, what brings you in today?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I have had a cough for about two weeks, and fever at night.
utterances.asr_text: I have had a cough for about two weeks, and fever at night.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Is the cough dry, or are you bringing up phlegm?
utterances.asr_text: Is the cough dry, or are you bringing up phlegm?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Mostly dry, but sometimes thoda yellow phlegm in the morning.
utterances.asr_text: Mostly dry, but sometimes thoda yellow phlegm in the morning.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Any chest pain or breathlessness?
utterances.asr_text: Any chest pain or breathlessness?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No chest pain. But I get a little breathless when I climb stairs.
utterances.asr_text: No chest pain. But I get a little breathless when I climb stairs.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Any blood in the phlegm?
utterances.asr_text: Any blood in the phlegm?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No, no blood.
utterances.asr_text: No, no blood.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: How high has the fever been?
utterances.asr_text: How high has the fever been?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I checked once at home, it was 100.8.
utterances.asr_text: I checked once at home, it was 100.8.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Are you taking your diabetes medicines regularly?
utterances.asr_text: Are you taking your diabetes medicines regularly?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Actually doctor, I stopped the metformin last week because it was upsetting my stomach.
utterances.asr_text: Actually doctor, I stopped the metformin last week because it was upsetting my stomach.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Okay. Any other medicines?
utterances.asr_text: Okay. Any other medicines?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Only the amlodipine every morning, that I am continuing.
utterances.asr_text: Only the amlodipine every morning, that I am continuing.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Any allergies to medicines?
utterances.asr_text: Any allergies to medicines?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, I am allergic to penicillin. I got a rash all over my body.
utterances.asr_text: Yes, I am allergic to penicillin. I got a rash all over my body.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Does anyone in the family have diabetes or heart problems?
utterances.asr_text: Does anyone in the family have diabetes or heart problems?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: My mother had diabetes, and my father had a heart attack at 60.
utterances.asr_text: My mother had diabetes, and my father had a heart attack at 60.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Do you smoke or drink?
utterances.asr_text: Do you smoke or drink?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: I used to smoke, but I quit 5 years ago. No alcohol.
utterances.asr_text: I used to smoke, but I quit 5 years ago. No alcohol.

utterances.speaker: family
utterances.text: Doctor, he still eats a lot of sweets, I keep telling him.
utterances.asr_text: Doctor, he still eats a lot of sweets, I keep telling him.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Okay, let me examine you. Please take a deep breath.
utterances.asr_text: Okay, let me examine you. Please take a deep breath.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: I can hear some crackles at the right lower lung base.
utterances.asr_text: I can hear some crackles at the right lower lung base.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Temperature is 99.4, and blood pressure is 138 over 86.
utterances.asr_text: Temperature is 99.4, and blood pressure is 138 over 86.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Oxygen saturation is 96 percent.
utterances.asr_text: Oxygen saturation is 96 percent.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Mr. Kumar, this looks like a chest infection, possibly early pneumonia on the right side.
utterances.asr_text: Mr. Kumar, this looks like a chest infection, possibly early pneumonia on the right side.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Since you are allergic to penicillin, I will not give you amoxicillin.
utterances.asr_text: Since you are allergic to penicillin, I will not give you amoxicillin.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: I am starting azithromycin 500 milligrams once daily for 5 days, after food.
utterances.asr_text: I am starting azithromycin 500 milligrams once daily for 5 days, after food.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: If the fever goes above 102, take paracetamol 650 milligrams, not more than 3 times a day.
utterances.asr_text: If the fever goes above 102, take paracetamol 650 milligrams, not more than 3 times a day.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Please get a chest X-ray and a complete blood count done today.
utterances.asr_text: Please get a chest X-ray and a complete blood count done today.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Also an HbA1c test, to see how your sugar control has been.
utterances.asr_text: Also an HbA1c test, to see how your sugar control has been.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: For the stomach upset, I am switching you to metformin extended release 500 milligrams once daily with dinner.
utterances.asr_text: For the stomach upset, I am switching you to metfromin extended release 500 milligrams once daily with dinner.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Doctor, will this cough medicine affect my sugar levels?
utterances.asr_text: Doctor, will this cough medicine affect my sugar levels?

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Drink plenty of warm fluids and take rest.
utterances.asr_text: Drink plenty of warm fluids and take rest.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: If you feel very breathless, or the fever does not come down in 3 days, come back immediately or go to the emergency.
utterances.asr_text: If you feel very breathless, or the fever does not come down in 3 days, come back immediately or go to the emergency.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Come back to see me after 1 week with the reports.
utterances.asr_text: Come back to see me after 1 week with the reports.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Okay doctor. Kal se office jaana hai, can I go to work?
utterances.asr_text: Okay doctor. Kal se office jaana hai, can I go to work?

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Better to rest for 2 days, then you can go to the office.
utterances.asr_text: Better to rest for 2 days, then you can go to the office.

utterances.speaker: family
utterances.text: Doctor, should he avoid sweets completely?
utterances.asr_text: Doctor, should he avoid sweets completely?

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Yes, avoid sweets and sugary drinks completely.
utterances.asr_text: Yes, avoid sweets and sugary drinks completely.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: One more thing, my neighbour gave me some hydroxyzine tablets for itching, I took 2 of them.
utterances.asr_text: One more thing, my neighbour gave me some hydrazine tablets for itching, I took 2 of them.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Please stop those tablets, and do not take any medicine without asking me.
utterances.asr_text: Please stop those tablets, and do not take any medicine without asking me.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: My receptionist will give you the lab slip.
utterances.asr_text: My receptionist will give you the lab slip.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Thank you doctor.
utterances.asr_text: Thank you doctor thank you thank you thank you thank you.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Take care, Mr. Kumar. Get well soon.
utterances.asr_text: Take care, Mr. Kumar. Get well soon.
